AgentConfigDefinitionGitCredentials.description: Integration whose git credentials the agent's machines use.

integration.description: Name of a GitHub integration in the project.

read_only.description: Prevents pushing and opening or approving pull requests, even if the integration allows it.

repository_ids.description: GitHub repository IDs the credentials can access. Defaults to every repository the installation can access.

AgentConfigDefinitionInteractionHandler.description: Enables an integration's interaction handler. Takes no settings.

AgentConfigDefinitionInteractionHandlers.description: Interaction handlers keyed by integration name.

region.description: AWS region to sign for. Required for sigv4 only.

secret_id.description: Secret holding the credential: generic for bearer, oauth_token_set for oauth, aws_credentials for sigv4.

service.description: AWS service to sign for, such as aws-mcp. Required for sigv4 only.

type.description: bearer sends a static token, oauth uses tokens from Omnara's MCP OAuth flow, and sigv4 signs requests with AWS SigV4.

auth.description: How to authenticate to the server. Omit if it needs none.

default_enabled.description: Whether tools are enabled unless overridden in tools. Defaults to true.

deferred.description: Keep the server's tools out of context until tool_search loads them. Defaults to false.

permission.description: Default permission for the server's tools. Defaults to always_ask.

tools.description: Per-tool overrides, keyed by the tool's name on the server.

url.description: HTTPS URL of the server's MCP endpoint.

deferred.description: Overrides the server's deferred setting. Null inherits it.

enabled.description: Enables or hides the tool. Null follows the server's default_enabled.

permission.description: Overrides the server's permission for this tool.

cwd.description: Working directory for the agent's processes. Overrides the machine or pool default.

delete_after_idle_minutes.description: Pools only. Delete a machine after this many idle minutes; 0 disables. Unset inherits the grant or pool setting.

description.description: Describes this source to the agent.

env_overlay.description: Environment variables for the agent's processes. A null value removes an inherited variable.

initial_num_machines.description: Pools only. Machines to create at launch. Defaults to 1 and cannot exceed max_machines.

machine_cpu.description: Pools only. vCPUs for new machines, within pool and project limits.

machine_memory_mb.description: Pools only. Memory in MB for new machines, within pool and project limits.

machine_name.description: Name of a BYO machine granted to the project. Set this or machine_pool_name.

machine_pool_name.description: Name of a machine pool granted to the project. Set this or machine_name.

machine_provider_options_overlay.description: Pools only. Provider options applied over the pool and grant options.

max_machines.description: Pools only. Most machines the agent can hold from this pool. Defaults to 1.

secret_env_overlay.description: Environment variables set from secrets (sec_...). A null value removes an inherited variable.

access.description: read, or read_write if the store also allows agent writes.

name.description: Name of a memory store in the project.

cache_retention.description: Prompt caching: none, short (provider default), or long (extended where available). Unset uses the model's default.

context_window_tokens.description: Context budget for input and output tokens. Triggers compaction when estimated input exceeds the remaining budget after output and safety reserves. The turn fails if compaction cannot make it fit.

default_max_output_tokens.description: Maximum output tokens per request. Overrides the model's default.

provider_config.description: Name of the organization's model provider.

reasoning.description: Reasoning effort, such as low, medium, or high, for models that support it.

archive_after_idle_minutes.description: Archive these subagents after this many idle minutes. Unset never archives them for being idle.

description.description: Tells the model when to spawn this subagent.

max_instances.description: Maximum active subagents from this key. Unset means no per-key limit.

model.description: Model overrides. Omit provider_config and name to keep the base model.

profile.description: Agent profile to launch from. Required when type is profile.

type.description: profile launches from a profile's current config; self copies this agent's config.

append.description: Text appended to the base instruction.

cache_retention.description: Overrides the base model's prompt caching.

context_window_tokens.description: Context budget for input and output tokens. Triggers compaction when estimated input exceeds the remaining budget after output and safety reserves. The turn fails if compaction cannot make it fit.

default_max_output_tokens.description: Overrides the base model's output token limit.

name.description: Configured model name. Set with provider_config to switch models.

provider_config.description: Model provider name. Set with name to switch models.

reasoning.description: Overrides the base model's reasoning effort.

deferred.description: Keep the tool out of context until tool_search loads it. Defaults to false.

description.description: Custom tools only. Tells the model what the tool does.

enabled.description: Set to false to disable the tool, including default tools.

input_schema.description: Custom tools only. JSON Schema for the tool's arguments.

permission.description: Overrides the tool's default permission. GET /tool-catalog lists defaults and modes.

type.description: built_in for an Omnara tool, custom for a tool your system runs.

AgentConfigDefinitionToolInputSchema.description: A JSON Schema for the tool's input. Keywords beyond those listed, such as additionalProperties or description, are allowed.

properties.description: Arguments, keyed by name, as JSON Schemas.

mode.description: always_allow, always_ask (wait for human approval), or always_deny.

parameters.description: Mode-specific settings. Current modes take none.

MemoryStoreName.description: Machine-readable memory store identifier consisting of lowercase ASCII segments separated by single hyphens.

ResourceNameReference.description: Name of an existing resource, resolved when the config is compiled.

description: An agent config as a JSON object. This schema is the source of truth for agent configs: the server compiles YAML and JSON configs against it.

git_credentials.description: GitHub integration whose credentials the agent's machine processes use for Git and gh. Not passed to subagents.

interaction_handlers.description: Integrations that show the agent's questions and approvals outside the dashboard, keyed by integration name. Not passed to subagents.

machine_sources.description: BYO machines and machine pools the agent can run commands on.

max_depth.description: Maximum subagent nesting depth. Defaults to 1, so subagents cannot spawn their own.

max_subagents.description: Maximum active subagents across all keys. Unset means no overall limit.

mcp.description: MCP servers the agent can use, keyed by server name. Their tools are named mcp__{server}__{tool}.

memory_stores.description: Project memory stores the agent can access at /memory/{name}/.

model.description: Model the agent runs on, with optional overrides of its defaults.

skills.description: IDs (skl_...) of skills the agent can load. The project must own or be granted each one.

subagents.description: Subagents the agent can spawn, keyed by name.

tools.description: Built-in and custom tools, keyed by tool name. {} enables a tool with its defaults.

version.description: Config format version. Only v1 exists.
